title: Club Metric0 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Club attendance (`club:attendance`), running-club sessions (`runningclub:session`), maker-space visits (`makerspace:visit`), book-club meetings (`bookclub:meeting`), community events (`community:event`).
app: Book-club attendance, running-club miles, maker-space visits, and general social-club participation logs streamed to Splunk HEC via forms, check-ins, and calendar exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=club:metric0 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in club metric0 events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme club metric0 records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It scans the unusually high or low value moments in your club metric0 history.
